name: Terrell Natural Gas Processing Plant
description: Natural gas processing facility that separates and captures CO₂ from the Barnett Shale gas stream. Captured CO₂ is compressed and delivered via Denbury's pipeline network for enhanced oil recovery.

name: Enid Fertilizer Plant
description: Ammonia and fertilizer plant capturing CO₂ from its steam methane reforming process. Captured CO₂ is transported for enhanced oil recovery.

name: Shute Creek Gas Plant (LaBarge)
description: One of the world's largest operating CCS projects, capturing CO₂ from the LaBarge natural gas field's raw gas. ExxonMobil is expanding capacity toward about 8 Mtpa; CO₂ is sold for enhanced oil recovery and dedicated geologic storage.

name: Great Plains Synfuels Plant
description: Coal-to-synthetic-natural-gas plant that captures CO₂ from its gasification process. Captured CO₂ is piped roughly 200 miles to the Weyburn and Midale fields in Saskatchewan, Canada for enhanced oil recovery.

name: Century Plant
description: Natural gas processing plant in the Permian Basin capturing CO₂ from the processed gas stream. Captured CO₂ feeds Occidental's Permian Basin enhanced oil recovery operations.

name: Air Products Port Arthur SMR
description: Steam methane reformer producing hydrogen for the Valero Port Arthur refinery, with CO₂ capture. Captured CO₂ is used for enhanced oil recovery in Texas.

name: Coffeyville Gasification Plant
description: Petroleum coke gasification and nitrogen fertilizer complex capturing CO₂ from ammonia production. Captured CO₂ is transported to Kansas and Oklahoma oilfields for enhanced oil recovery.

name: Lost Cabin Gas Plant
description: Natural gas processing plant capturing CO₂ from the gas stream. Captured CO₂ is compressed and piped for enhanced oil recovery.

name: Petra Nova
description: Post-combustion amine capture system on a unit of the W.A. Parish coal plant. It captured well below its ~1.4 Mtpa design target, was idled in 2020, and restarted in late 2023 at reduced rates.

name: ADM Decatur (Illinois Industrial CCS)
description: Ethanol plant capturing fermentation CO₂ and injecting it into the deep Mt. Simon Sandstone saline formation, one of the first large US saline-storage CCS operations.

name: Arkalon CO2 Compression Facility
description: Ethanol plant CO₂ compression facility sending captured CO₂ to Kansas and Oklahoma oilfields for enhanced oil recovery.

name: Bonanza BioEnergy
description: Ethanol plant capturing fermentation CO₂ for enhanced oil recovery in nearby Kansas oilfields.

name: Denbury/ExxonMobil Gulf Coast CO2 Network
description: Large operating network of CO₂ pipelines and enhanced oil recovery fields across the Gulf Coast, including the Green Pipeline. ExxonMobil is expanding it into a CO₂ 'superhighway' for new capture projects and permanent storage.

name: Stratos Direct Air Capture
description: First commercial-scale US direct air capture plant, designed to remove up to 500,000 tonnes of CO₂ per year. Began startup in 2025 with captured CO₂ destined for dedicated saline storage (Class VI wells) and potential EOR.

name: NET Power Project Permian
description: First utility-scale NET Power oxy-combustion natural gas plant (~300 MW) designed to inherently capture its CO₂. Under construction in the Permian Basin with captured CO₂ targeted for enhanced oil recovery and storage.

name: Summit Carbon Solutions Pipeline
description: Pipeline network designed to capture CO₂ from more than 50 ethanol plants across Iowa, Minnesota, Nebraska, South Dakota and North Dakota and transport it to permanent geologic storage in North Dakota. The largest planned US ethanol-carbon-capture system.

name: Project Cypress DAC Hub
description: DOE-supported regional direct air capture hub in southwest Louisiana combining multiple DAC technologies with dedicated saline storage. Awarded funding under the DOE Regional DAC Hubs program.

name: South Texas DAC Hub
description: DOE-supported regional direct air capture hub on the King Ranch in south Texas, building on Stratos technology and targeting up to 1 Mtpa of removal with saline storage.

name: Heirloom Carbon DAC (Louisiana)
description: Direct air capture developer planning commercial limestone-based DAC capacity in Louisiana, tied to the Project Cypress hub and regional storage infrastructure.

name: Project Bison
description: Modular solid-sorbent direct air capture project planned in Wyoming with a long-term target of 5 Mtpa by 2030, supported by state incentives.

name: San Juan Generating Station CCS
description: Proposed post-combustion CCS retrofit of the San Juan coal plant to capture most of its CO₂ for enhanced oil recovery in the Permian and San Juan basins. Facing financing and permitting hurdles.

name: Project Tundra
description: Planned post-combustion CCS retrofit of the Milton R. Young lignite-fired power station, with CO₂ destined for enhanced oil recovery and saline storage in North Dakota.

name: Bayou Bend CCS
description: Offshore CO₂ storage hub in Texas state waters of the Gulf of Mexico with large saline-storage capacity, positioned to serve Gulf Coast industrial emitters.

name: Wabash Valley Resources
description: Planned ammonia and fertilizer plant with CO₂ capture and injection into a deep saline formation in Indiana, a first-of-kind zero-emission ammonia facility in the state.

name: ADM Cedar Rapids CCS
description: Planned carbon capture and sequestration at ADM's Cedar Rapids ethanol complex, building on the company's Decatur, Illinois operations.

name: Tallgrass Trailblazer CO2 Pipeline
description: Proposed conversion of a natural gas pipeline into a CO₂ trunk line to move captured CO₂ from Wyoming and Nebraska emitters to geologic storage and enhanced oil recovery.
